neet-ug.name: NEET-UG
neet-ug.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English. About 50% in PCB for General (40% for reserved categories). Age 17 or more by 31 December of the admission year.
neet-ug.leads: MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, BVSc and several allied courses

kcet.name: KCET (Karnataka)
kcet.marking: 1 mark each, no negative marking, 80 minutes per paper
kcet.eligibility: 2nd PUC or Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Maths or Biology. About 45% for General, 40% for reserved categories. Rank uses 50% KCET and 50% PUC marks.
kcet.leads: Engineering, B.Pharm, BSc Nursing, agriculture seats in Karnataka

cuet-ug.name: CUET-UG
cuet-ug.total: Up to 5 subjects including language and general test
cuet-ug.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Each university sets its own subject combination.
cuet-ug.leads: BSc, BCom, BA and other degrees at central and many state universities

iiser-iat.name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
iiser-iat.eligibility: Class 12 Science with at least three of Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Maths. Minimum 60% (55% for SC/ST/PwD).

jee-main.name: JEE Main
jee-main.marking: +4 for correct, -1 for wrong MCQ. Check the bulletin for numerical questions.
jee-main.eligibility: Class 12 passed or appearing. No minimum percentage to appear. NITs and IIITs usually ask for about 75% in Class 12 or a top 20 percentile.
jee-main.leads: NITs, IIITs, other engineering colleges, JEE Advanced for IITs

bitsat.name: BITSAT
rows: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, English, Logical reasoning
bitsat.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English. High aggregate and per-subject minimums apply, so check the brochure.
bitsat.leads: BE and BTech at BITS campuses

nda.name: NDA and NA (UPSC)
nda.marking: Negative marking of one-third in the written papers
nda.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Army wing: any stream. Air Force and Navy: Physics and Maths. Unmarried, about 16.5 to 19.5 years of age.
nda.leads: Army, Navy and Air Force officer training with a degree

nata.name: NATA (Architecture)
nata.mode: Drawing test and online aptitude test, 3 hours
nata.eligibility: Class 12 with Physics and Maths. About 45% aggregate for the Council of Architecture. Colleges often ask more.

ca-foundation.name: CA Foundation (ICAI)
ca-foundation.body: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
ca-foundation.total: 400 marks. Papers 1 and 2 are descriptive, 3 and 4 are objective.
ca-foundation.marking: 0.25 negative in the objective papers. Pass needs 40% in each paper and 50% overall.
ca-foundation.eligibility: Class 12 pass. Register at least four months before the exam.

cseet.name: CSEET (ICSI)
cseet.body: Institute of Company Secretaries of India
cseet.total: Revised pattern reported as four 100-mark papers

cma-foundation.name: CMA Foundation (ICMAI)
cma-foundation.body: Institute of Cost Accountants of India
cma-foundation.marking: Pass needs 40% in each paper and 50% overall
cma-foundation.eligibility: Class 12 pass, or appearing with provisional registration.

ipmat.name: IPMAT (IIM Indore and Rohtak)
ipmat.eligibility: Class 12 passed or appearing. Age and percentage rules differ for Indore and Rohtak, so check each.

clat.name: CLAT (UG)
clat.eligibility: Class 12 or equivalent, appearing candidates allowed. About 45% (40% for SC/ST).
clat.leads: BA LLB at National Law Universities and many private law schools
